vehicles.search: Search by name, plate, make or person
vehicles.empty: You don't have any vehicles yet. Add them from the map and their profile will show up here.

dialog.title: Vehicle profile
dialog.expiringDot: there are documents about to expire

profile.badYear: The year has four digits, like 2022.
profile.noPhoto: No photo. Upload it in Documents
profile.nameNote: The name, plate and group are changed from the map, on the vehicle.

state.availabilityNow: Now: {{value}}, since {{since}}. “On route” isn't chosen: an available vehicle is on route while it's moving.
state.stateNow: Now: {{value}}, since {{since}}. A suspended or retired vehicle keeps reporting if its GPS is connected; this only records its status.

assigned.drivers: This account keeps its drivers in their own module: here you see who drove the vehicle and when. To change who drives it, do it from the map, on the vehicle.
assigned.manual: Who the vehicle is assigned to and between which dates. When it's assigned to someone else, the previous open assignment ends the day before.
assigned.empty: It hasn't been assigned to anyone yet.

documents.note: Photos (JPG, PNG, WebP) or PDF. The photo you upload as “Vehicle photo” becomes the one on its profile.
documents.empty: This vehicle has no saved documents.

life.salvage: The salvage value can't be higher than the purchase price.
life.empty: With the purchase date and price and the years of useful life, its depreciation, its book value and what it has cost to own show up here.
life.salvageHint: What it will be worth at the end of its useful life.

expenses.title: Operating expenses
expenses.endBeforeStart: The end date can't be earlier than the start date.
expenses.emptyManage: No expenses in this period. Record tolls, fines, insurance, repairs and anything else you pay for each vehicle.
expenses.removeBody: The {{amount}} expense of {{vehicle}}, from {{date}}, will be deleted.
expenses.needAmount: Enter the amount, greater than zero.

groups.title: Group tree
groups.note: Branches, zones, routes or whatever helps you organize the fleet
groups.lead: A group can sit under another one: for example, “North zone” with “San Pedro Sula” and “La Ceiba” under it. Whoever has permission over a group also sees the ones under it, and a group's alerts, geofences and reports include them.
groups.empty: You don't have any groups yet.
groups.emptyManage: You don't have any groups yet. Create the first one below.
groups.footer: To rename or delete a group, use “Groups” on the map. Each vehicle is put in its group when you edit it.

usage.title: Fleet usage
usage.lead: How much each vehicle worked and how long it went unused · {{period}}
usage.footer: “Unused” is the share of the period's days on which the vehicle made no trip. In red, the ones that went unused four out of every five days or more.
